Mira (People Ops): Drafting a one-line travel FAQ. Need to lock per-diem, receipts threshold, spouse rules, and booking flow. Quick answers pls.
Ethan (Sales): Hotel cap for client travel? Is $300 still ok?
Hank (Finance): Client-facing roles: up to $300/night with manager pre-approval. General guideline: $250/night, high-cost metros $350. Pre-approve in TravelPerk or attach manager approval for reimbursements.
Kira (Eng): Meals: per-diem vs receipts rules? Can you mix days?
Hank (Finance): You can mix days across a trip, but not both for the same calendar day. Domestic per-diem (meals only) = $75/day. International uses country rates; add country code to claim.
Ethan (Sales): Small items under $25  receipts?
Hank (Finance): Receipts required for any single transaction >= $25. Under $25, log as "misc" with a short note; no receipt needed unless the merchant provides one.
Kira (Eng): Lost taxi receipt, what do I do?
Hank (Finance): If <= $50 include a brief explanation. If > $50 upload a Missing Receipt Affidavit and include manager sign-off. Finance will review exceptions case-by-case.
Mira (People Ops): Spouse/guest expenses? We've had asks.
Hank (Finance): Default: not reimbursable. Exceptions only with manager + Finance pre-approval for documented business reasons; only business portion reimbursed.
Mira (People Ops): Currency conversion for out-of-pocket?
Hank (Finance): Corporate card uses bank FX rate. For reimbursements use the expense tools rate (or XE on purchase date) and attach proof if > $500 USD equivalent.
TravelBot: Reminder: submit all expenses within 60 days of trip end or claim may be denied. Link: https://redwood.example/internal/travel-policy
Mira (People Ops): I'll publish this checklist and add a tiny upload snippet for engineers. Please ack.
Kira (Eng): Ack. The snippet would help.

```
{
  "date": "2026-11-02",

  "converted_usd": "45.10",

  "manager_approval": "ethan@example.com"
}
```
Hank (Finance): Finance will process expedited claims (tag "expedite" + manager OK) in 2-3 business days. Standard claims follow normal cycles.
Mira (People Ops): Thanks everyone, publishing now :memo:
